extensionDescription.message: Crash-proof tab session backup and idle tab memory guardian for Firefox.

notif_crash_message.message: It looks like the previous Firefox session ended uncleanly. Click to open the last tab backup.

popup_subtitle.message: Session backup + idle tab memory guardian

status_nothing_to_discard.message: Nothing to discard - everything is already free

label_protect_forms.message: Do not discard tabs with unsaved forms

label_smart_activation.message: Smart activation when closing a tab

help_smart_activation.message: When you close the active tab, Firefox sometimes focuses an already-discarded neighbor - which then starts reloading. This option immediately moves focus to another already-loaded tab.

label_mark_discarded.message: Mark discarded tabs with a title prefix

help_mark_discarded.message: A discarded tab title becomes e.g. «💤 Page title» - visible in Firefox's tab strip, not only in the popup. You can use your own text or emoji. Does not work on every page (about: and AMO block scripts).

label_whitelist.message: Never discard these domains (one per line)

help_whitelist.message: Subdomains are matched automatically: example.com also covers www.example.com.

help_discard_shortcut.message: Discard-all-except-current shortcut: Alt+Shift+D. Remap it in about:addons if it conflicts.

help_presets.message: A profile only fills the fields below - you can still edit them and press Save.

label_max_snapshots.message: How many snapshots to keep (by count)

label_max_backup_mb.message: History size limit, MB (0 = no extra limit)

help_retention.message: When snapshots exceed the count or size limit, the oldest are trimmed first - but the latest snapshot is never deleted, even if it alone exceeds the limit.

help_import.message: Import understands our format, plus common shapes from other tab managers (URL lists, objects with tabs/windows/sessions/snapshots) and plain-text link lists - bad rows are skipped instead of failing the whole import.

help_prune_log.message: Shows when older snapshots were trimmed by a limit, or a snapshot was skipped as empty/corrupt - instead of silent history loss.

empty_prune_log.message: Empty so far - limits have never fired

status_preset_applied.message: Profile applied - don't forget to Save

status_import_empty.message: Nothing found to import - check the file
